instruction: Add all spotify-recommended classical songs released in this year to a new "Spotify Recommended Songs" playlist.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus the login-free phone.get_current_date_and_time, which establishes (current-date-known) so that 'this year' can be resolved; the year and genre are modeled as discrete objects (year-2023, classical) with static facts (current-year ...) and (target-genre ...). show_recommendations (paginated at runtime, one action in the model) makes the recommended song ids known via (recommendations-listed); show_song reveals each song's genre/release year; add_song_to_playlist is only applicable to songs whose details are known and that match the target genre and current year, so non-qualifying recommended songs (rec-song-3: old release, rec-song-4: wrong genre) can never be added, matching the evaluation that added songs equal exactly the classical/this-year recommended set. The number of recommended and qualifying songs is illustrative (4 recommended, 2 qualifying); at runtime the agent must call show_song for every recommendation to perform the filter, so the reference api_sequence lists four show_song calls even though a cost-minimizing planner will only emit show_song for the two qualifying songs. supervisor.complete_task takes the task records (playlist, title, the two qualifying songs) as non-API parameters so that its precondition mirrors every goal condition; it is called with no answer (status success). The supervisor object jason-simpson is declared for completeness but is not referenced by any predicate.
